text:
Harpreet S: @channel Quick launch note: we’re opening RTX6000 dedicated pools in sa-east-1 (zones a and b) next week. This is targeted at customers needing better FP32 throughput for model fine-tuning and large-batch reranks.
Marta V: are these reserved-only or will we offer preemptible variants?
Harpreet S: reserved-only initially. We’ll evaluate preemptible after 6 weeks of steady telemetry.
FieldEng: Can we get an ETA and any tenancy policy changes?
Harpreet S: ETA: preview starts 2025-12-01 UTC, GA 2025-12-08. New policy: "priority-tenancy" flag will allow enterprise customers to reserve exclusive AZ tenancy for latency-sensitive workloads (opt-in).
SRE-Oncall: What limits are we imposing so we don't starve other pools?
Harpreet S: cap per-customer to 30% of the new pool by default, increase by exception. Also global ramp-down if cross-region burst >25%.
OpsBot: [automated] Created reminders: preview 7d/1d; capacity ramp will be throttled using the new quota controller.
FieldEng: Any billing deltas?
Billing: RTX6000 reserved price = h200_reserved * 1.12; enterprise priority-tenancy surcharge = fixed $0.04/hour per GPU. Prorated credits for upgrades will be applied.
Marta V: compatibility note: some older tensor cores may require driver 525+. Eng-Infra, please publish AMI/container images.
Harpreet S: Eng-Infra will push images and a validation checklist by EOD Friday.
SRE-Oncall: I'll add alerts: `dedicated.rtx6000.sa-east.capacity_pressure` and `dedicated.priority-tenancy.violations`.
FieldEng: We should notify currently pinned customers in sa-east-1 so they can request priority-tenancy if needed.
Harpreet S: Agreed — Support will send targeted messages and add a console banner with a request flow. Link to draft plan: <https://go.redwood.ai/internal/dedicated/rtx6000-sa-east-launch>
Billing: Action: publish line-item `rtx6000_priority_fee` and update pricing page before GA.
Harpreet S: Thanks team. Action items: Eng-Infra publish images (EOD Fri), Support send targeted comms (Mon), SRE add alerts (preview window), Billing update pricing docs (pre-GA).
